title: BambooHR pricing - $10-$25/employee/month, $250/month minimum for small teams
clean_text: BambooHR has no public rate card; based on third-party buyer reports, pricing runs roughly $10/employee/month on Core, $17/employee/month on Pro, and $25/employee/month on Elite. Companies with 25 or fewer employees hit a flat $250/month minimum regardless of tier. Adding Payroll ($4-6 PEPM) and Benefits Administration ($3-6 PEPM) typically brings total cost to $14-16/employee/month, with additional modules or Pro-tier upgrades reaching $18-25+/employee/month. Because quotes are negotiated individually, two companies of the same size can pay different rates depending on signup timing and selected add-ons.
